content.text: Hello! Today we will learn basic English greetings. Greetings are very important when meeting new people. Let's start with the most common ones.
The most common greeting is 'Hello'. It's formal and polite. 'Hi' is more casual and used with friends. Both mean the same thing - a friendly greeting.
We use time-specific greetings. 'Good morning' is used until noon. 'Good afternoon' is from noon until evening. 'Good evening' is used at night. These show respect and awareness of time.
After greeting, people often ask 'How are you?'. Common responses are 'I'm fine, thank you' or 'I'm good'. This shows care for the other person's wellbeing.
Let's practice together. Repeat after me: Hello. Hi. Good morning. Good afternoon. Good evening. How are you? Excellent! You're doing great!
Today we learned basic English greetings: Hello, Hi, Good morning, Good afternoon, Good evening, and How are you. Practice these every day. See you in the next lesson! Goodbye!
